Torikatsu
By: Esther Gomez
Published: Saturday, March 6, 2010 - 5:25am

Ingredients




2 chicken breast fillet
salt

pepper

1 egg
flour

panko (Japanese breadcrumbs)

Preparation

1 Pound the chicken breast fillet with your fist. 2 Slice them into strips. 3 Season with salt and pepper. 4 Dredge the chicken pieces in flour then dip in egg. 5 Roll in panko then deep fry in hot oil 6 Make sure that your oil is just the right temperature. 7 If it's too hot, it will burn the panko and leave your chicken raw. 8 Remove when golden brown and drain in paper towels. 9 Serve with tonkatsu sauce and rice.

About


Torikatsu is chicken katsu. It's a healthier alternative to tonkatsu which is pork.I love Japanese food. This is one of those very simple dishes that I make whenever the craving hits. Dining in a Japanese restaurant can be quite expensive. This is a cheap alternative. I only spent around Php50 (about $1) for this. You can buy bottled tonkatsu sauce (Bulldog brand) in Asian groceries or online. For more quick and easy Japanese recipes, visit my blog at www.240baon.blogspot.com.
